decisions_2026_10_10.data_path: Melee / Slippi telemetry, replays supplied locally by the user
decisions_2026_10_10.annotation: provisional single annotator (user); ineligible for paired lexical claims until a second independent annotator and a third adjudicator are added

question: Can VLMs ground gaming-community jargon in visual gameplay evidence, and does jargon wording help or hurt against meaning-matched plain wording?
freeze_rule: Changing any frozen file, the episode registry, or the frame-selection rule creates plan v2. Eval annotations and these templates must be frozen (hash recorded here) before any model output is imported.

units.split_unit: lineage group (replay, plus session/set when a --sessions map is supplied); never frames
units.near_duplicates: identical replay SHA-256 deduplicated; all candidates from one replay share replay_id and parent_sample_id so prepare keeps them together

cells.pairing: All six cells on the same underlying example
cells.seed_semantics: Closed APIs here expose no sampling seed (temperature is removed on Claude Opus 5.5 / Sonnet 5.5). The seed fixes the listed label-option order and the request order; three independent calls per cell measure provider nondeterminism plus presentation order.

frame_selection_rule.clip: candidate event_frames padded per family (wavedash 20/20, L-cancel 12/20, dashdancing 12/12, short hop 8/12, edgehogging 30/30 native frames), end-exclusive, native 60 Hz Slippi clock
frame_selection_rule.policy: preserve all native frames when the clip is 64 frames or fewer; otherwise uniform by ordinal position with every key frame and its predecessor required (defining transitions are never dropped)
frame_selection_rule.index_space: native Slippi frames; translate to rendered video indices only through a reviewed rendered_manifest.jsonl frame_map
frame_selection_rule.render_spec_to_record: Dolphin/Slippi build, 640x480 internal resolution or record actual, no HUD/input-display overlays, audio off, native 60 Hz, alignment checked at start/middle/end

prompts.gold_withheld: renderer accepts only the allowlisted keys of inputs.jsonl row.input and refuses any other key; gold, reviews, candidate kind/stratum, rule evidence, inventory definitions and usage quotes never enter a request
prompts.request_A_label: term or plain description + evidence -> label, event_interval_seconds, confidence
prompts.request_B_property_probe: separate request, neutral property questions shared by both wording arms (term and plain description omitted), per evidence modality; not_observable properties omitted
prompts.ordering: system, frames with timestamps, text evidence, worded question last (shared cacheable prefix; wording varies only in the final block)

gold_and_scoring.gold: condition-specific gold_by_condition wherever a label-decisive property is telemetry_only or context_dependent (L-cancel visual arms expected INSUFFICIENT by design); unequal-information examples are diagnostic and excluded from paired lexical-effect claims
metrics: label accuracy and macro-F1 over PRESENT/ABSENT/INSUFFICIENT
critical-property exact agreement from request B
gold_and_scoring.contrasts: paired jargon minus plain within each evidence modality; visual and both minus text within each wording; per family and pooled
gold_and_scoring.uncertainty: 1,000 bootstrap resamples over independent lineage groups
gold_and_scoring.merge_rule: request A label and request B properties are merged per item_id into one response row per replication before score_responses (implementation pending)

cached_prefix_scenario_eval.assumption: 18 visual-bearing requests per example share a ~27,000-token system+frames prefix: 1 cache write at 1.25x plus 17 reads at 0.1x; hits within TTL unverified

cost_estimate.batch_api: 50% discount where applicable; not applied in headline
unknowns: image tokens per 640x480 frame on current models (w*h/750 assumed; verify with count_tokens)
maximum images per request per provider (64 frames may exceed a limit; a montage fallback would be a pixel transform and needs plan v2)
actual eval episode count after adjudication
frames per clip (64 is a ceiling)
OpenAI/Gemini model IDs, prices and video/image accounting

reference_points.B0_prior: per-family majority label and always-PRESENT, from dev gold

B1_vision_only_probe.model: frozen CLIP-class image encoder (e.g. open_clip ViT-B/32), no fine-tuning
B1_vision_only_probe.input: identical selected frames (<=64) as the VLM visual arm
B1_vision_only_probe.features: per-clip mean and max of frame embeddings plus mean absolute consecutive-frame embedding difference
B1_vision_only_probe.classifier: per-family L2 logistic regression, PRESENT vs not-PRESENT; regularization chosen by grouped CV on training groups only
training_data: separate pool of detector-proposed windows from replays disjoint from every Stage 1 lineage group, labelled by telemetry rules (label source: telemetry_rule, never human gold)
B1_vision_only_probe.evaluation: eval split, visual-arm gold; cannot abstain, so report on PRESENT/ABSENT items plus coverage
B1_vision_only_probe.requires_approval: downloads of torch/open_clip and encoder weights (several hundred MB); local CPU/MPS compute on the M3

B2_telemetry_rule_reference.model: melee_mining rules (ruleset melee-mining-v1) on the same eval windows
B2_telemetry_rule_reference.mapping: positive_candidate -> PRESENT, near_miss_candidate -> ABSENT, no proposal -> ABSENT
B2_telemetry_rule_reference.scored_against: event_reference_label: a protected label reviewed with full video plus telemetry access (annotation extension needed before freeze)
B2_telemetry_rule_reference.interpretation: information reference (privileged state), not a visual upper bound
B2_telemetry_rule_reference.circularity_control: annotators see clips and raw telemetry but never the rule's kind, stratum or evidence; report rule-human agreement separately

item_level_plan_command: zsh multimodal_game_eval/run_offline.sh plan --episodes <ABSOLUTE frozen Stage 1 episodes.jsonl> --config <ABSOLUTE multimodal_game_eval/configs/stage2_vlm.json> --output <ABSOLUTE artifacts path>
limitations: No model, human gold or real media result exists; every number above is a projection or synthetic check.
Melee action-state constants and peppi field names are unverified on real replays.
Provisional single-annotator labels cannot support paired lexical-effect claims.
Inventory senses rest on one SSBWiki page for all Melee families; meanings are unadjudicated.
Text-arm observations must be written by reviewers from visible events without privileged telemetry; this is manual.
